| **Undergraduate aerospace‑engineering degree** | FSU’s Department of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering offers a **Bachelor of Science (BS) in Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering** – a full undergraduate program that includes aerospace‑engineering coursework.
